====

WHAT YOU WILL LEARN
----
• Say what methods of price determination — topic synthesis and practice means in plain words.
• Give one Kenyan example linked to Methods of Price Determination.
• Correct one common mistake about this page.

INTRODUCTION
----
A learner studying BUSINESS STUDIES meets methods of price determination — topic synthesis and practice first by naming the idea, then by using one Kenyan example from a school compound in Machakos. In plain words: explore factors influencing demand and supply for a product,.

• Methods of Price Determination — Topic Synthesis and Practice helps you understand Methods of Price Determination in BUSINESS STUDIES.

WORKED EXAMPLE
----
Worked situation at a school compound in Machakos: a learner investigates methods of price determination — topic synthesis and practice within Methods of Price Determination. First, state the idea clearly: Understand and practise: explore factors influencing demand and supply for a product, Next, apply it to one object or action at a school compound in Machakos and name what changes or what stays the same. Finally, write one accurate conclusion sentence a teacher could tick — using the correct subject words for BUSINESS STUDIES.

IN EVERYDAY LIFE

At a school compound in Machakos, practise methods of price determination — topic synthesis and practice during ordinary routines at home or school. Ask: what did I observe, which word fits, and how do I check I am right? Safety and respect come first.

REVISION QUESTIONS
----
1. Define methods of price determination — topic synthesis and practice in your own words and give one clear example.
2. Describe a situation at a school compound in Machakos that shows Methods of Price Determination, using ideas from this page.
3. A learner makes a mistake about methods of price determination — topic synthesis and practice. State the wrong idea, correct it, and justify your correction.

ANSWERS
----
